name: restaurant-attendance
description: Face + location-marker attendance for small restaurants: Flutter app, Next.js portal, Firebase backend

scripts.setup: npm run install:functions && npm run install:portal && npm run install:scripts && npm run install:rules-tests && npm run setup:env
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t='apps/portal/.env.local';if(fs.existsSync(t)){console.log(t+' already exists, leaving it alone.')}else{fs.copyFileSync('apps/portal/.env.local.example',t);console.log('Created '+t+' — fill it in, or keep the emulator defaults.')}"
scripts.emulators:seed: firebase --project restaurant-attendance-demo --config firebase/firebase.json emulators:exec "npm run seed"
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:mobile
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck:functions && npm run typecheck:portal && npm run analyze:mobile
